tier_or_band: Inside City Limits; up to 14 fixture units (1 LUE)
methodology_formula: Sewer System Connection Fees charged based on fixture units, with the base fee for a Living Unit Equivalent (LUE) being for a single family home with one bathroom, kitchen, dishwasher and washing machine having 14 fixture units.
